review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer - IT | Saudi Arabia
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Senior Network Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and supporting enterprise network infrastructure, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across LAN, WAN, MPLS, satellite/VSAT, wireless, and mobility environments. The role requires a highly experienced network professional capable of managing complex network operations, troubleshooting critical incidents, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, and providing technical guidance
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Configure and manage Palo Alto and FortiGate firewalls , including security policies, NAT, VPN, access control, and network security requirements. Minimum 5–7 years of experience in enterprise network engineering, preferably within a large-scale technology or enterprise environment. Strong hands-on experience with LAN, WAN, MPLS, satellite/VSAT, wireless, and mobility networks . Hands-on experience with Palo Alto and FortiGate firewalls , including network security, policies, NAT, VPN, and access control.
